Edition.description: One edition of the paper: its date in the common calendar and in the Hebrew one, and the holiday it falls on, if any.

hebrewDate.description: The edition's date in the Hebrew calendar, written in Hebrew letters.

hebrewMonth.description: The Hebrew month, by its number from 1 to 13, counted from Nisan.

holiday.description: The holiday the edition falls on or near, where there is one.

key.description: The edition's key: its date alone for the first paper, or the paper's code and a hyphen before that date for any other paper. Its date must equal date; the source register supplies the paper's code.

newspaper.description: The paper this edition belongs to, by its id in the source register.

object_url.description: The holder's descriptive page for this one issue.

Edition.title: Edition

EditionsCatalog.description: The catalog of editions: every edition, the holidays and historical events beside them, and the dates available on the site.

availableDates.description: The dates of the editions whose pages are on the site.

editions.description: Every edition of the paper, with its Hebrew date.

historicalEvents.description: Events in the world outside the town that the calendar marks.

holidays.description: The Jewish holidays of the paper's years.

newspapers.description: The papers these editions belong to, one entry per source-register id, with their default picture credits. When present, every edition's newspaper must name one of these ids. The runtime twins enforce id uniqueness and membership; LinkML's generated JSON Schema cannot compare values across these lists.

HistoricalEvent.description: An event in the world outside the town, such as Kristallnacht, on a day or over a span of days.

date.description: The day the event began, written YYYY-MM-DD.

description.description: What happened, in a sentence or two.

endDate.description: The day the event ended, where it lasted more than a day.

HistoricalEvent.title: HistoricalEvent

Holiday.description: A Jewish holiday on a given day.

hebrewName.description: The holiday's name in Hebrew letters, where it is given.

name.description: The holiday's name in Latin letters, such as Purim or Pesach.

Holiday.title: Holiday

Newspaper.description: One newspaper in the source register, with its site title, code and default picture credit. A page may supply a different credit through picture_source.

code.description: The paper's lowercase alphabetic code used in site keys and routes.

holder.description: The name of the institution holding the pages the pictures were made from.

id.description: The paper's source-register id, the same value as Edition.newspaper.

rights.description: The rights statement for the pictures, as text.

rights_url.description: The address where the rights statement was read.

route.description: The name of the service or collection readers reach the pages through, when it differs from the holder itself.

shelf_mark.description: The holder's shelf mark or call number for the pages.

title.description: The paper's title as the site shows it.

url.description: The pages' descriptive page at the holder or access route.

url.description: The pages' descriptive page at the holder or access route.
